verdict.rationale: Tavily's core functionality (search, extract, crawl, map, research, Q&A, RAG context) is fully exposed through the API/SDKs, and CLI/MCP integrations mirror this, suggesting the API is the primary interface with no UI-only features documented. However, there's no explicit comparison confirming full UI-API parity, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (404 on all probed paths), leaving some doubt about completeness of self-service API discovery. Missing for 10: explicit UI feature list to compare against API, and a public OpenAPI/swagger spec for full endpoint parity verification.
